description: Repay COOK debt. `amount` in COOK, or "all" to clear the loan (wraps a few slots of extra interest so it cannot come up short; the excess is returned in the same transaction). Overpaying is safe: the program only takes what is owed. Repay works even while the protocol is paused. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

asset.description: asset to repay; only needed with several
